method.source: Whole unique reachable input files, including nested trusted entry graph. Mixed input files are conservatively charged to local exposure.
method.executablePlacement: Local means root/child windows, dedicated/shared/publisher workers and worklets. Controller means SW/connect only. Placement is build reachability, not a security proof.
method.virtual: Embedded code string is not counted again as maintained source; its deployed bytes remain included in outer bundles.
method.nested: Separate nested build reproduces trusted-policy plugin entry/settings. Nested emitted size is diagnostic; never add again to outer deployment total.
method.versions: Baseline and current both resolve measuring worktree node_modules. Lock hash is recorded; dependency versions must be checked before comparing with historical release assets.
method.scope: Working-tree development snapshot, not a release or a code-reduction/security gate pass.
